items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: No, I can't tell you nothing about Raymond Brown. ... I used to hear about Raymond Brown. And didn't Raymond live somewhere in college? ... I used to hear him talk about him.

ctx.x: That's right. Well when he took sick, he played that Bulls Parade. And I didn't want him to go play, he was sick. He was 26. He got out of the band when he played the Bulls Parade and come home and got the band. Then the Monday, he had an Artfellas Parade across the river. And I begged him. And this child's godfather played too in the band. And he begged, he said, George, don't go play that Bulls Parade. I'll give you that $10 out of my pocket. He said, no Brown, my word is my bond. And he went and played. I…
Did he have any other teachers or did he?
